method: Synthetic generality models (python/tests/synthetic.py, docs/testing.md). The reference is an independent float64 numpy implementation of the spec, rounded to F32. synthetic-fp32: engine fp32 (CPU and CUDA) vs the reference, 1e-5 per key (measured worst 9.2e-7; see docs/testing.md), 1e-6 for copies and input assembly (in.x, in.x_norm, enc.x_src, enc.x_dst; bitwise in practice). synthetic-fp16: engine CUDA fp16 vs the same reference, single value for all non-exact keys, about 2x the worst measured over all models and keys (docs/testing.md). Metric: rel_absmax (docs/format.md section 2).
